senses.en: to glitter (as shoes or a pan)
to grind to pieces, to press out oil (as with soybeans)
to check traps, to go to see if animals are trapped, ensnared
to move or slide like a snake, worm or eel, to crawl like a snake
to flash light with pine tree
to dig up (a potato, peanuts, etc.)
a type of freshwater fish, catfish
